nodes.label: Gate-2 Prediction Test Spec
nodes.rationale: Post-partition P1 chosen and re-entry P2 rejected because re-entry silently becomes a different strategy; unknown kept as a third group because dsl.evaluate_bool fillna(False) would misfile warmup bars.

nodes.label: Gate 2 — the prediction test
nodes.rationale: Post-partition only (P1): because walk_table holds one position at a time, suppressing an early entry under a re-entry design would open a later one, so subset and complement would stop partitioning one population. Gate 1's entry rotation cannot substitute for a gate-2 trade-level null.

nodes.label: Gate 2 prediction test (block bootstrap)
nodes.rationale: A common-calendar non-overlapping block bootstrap, not a label permutation: trades cluster in calendar time on a market-wide rule and a permutation would price a shared-regime coincidence as information. Unknown is a third group because evaluate_bool's fillna(False) fabricates a reading.
